title.narrative: Supporting the Electricity Transmission System project (13th Development Plan)

description.narrative:
The project aims at promoting the economic growth, improving the living standards of the population, and satisfying the increasing demand for electricity in the unified power system in Tunisia through supporting the electricity transmission system. The project will help in reducing the technical losses in the network and increasing the reliability of the power transmission system.
Supporting the Electricity Transmission System is an energy efficiency project, which aim at supporting STEG in its endeavor to supply its clients without interruption, while ensuring low and acceptable power losses. On completion, the project will (i) augment the transformation capacity of the network by 1680 MVA, (ii) increase the transmission lines length by 210 km, and (iii) Reduce the power losses to less than 2%.
